notes: Validated against Kellenberger CA et al. Science 2015. GEMM-Ib riboswitch from Geobacter metallireducens. Ligand 4BW (3,3-cGAMP = cyclic AMP-GMP with mixed 3-5 linkage) at R:106. MG and K removed per policy. GTP R:1 (5-terminal) included in receptor. Chain R used. Completes cyclic dinucleotide family: c-di-GMP-I, c-di-GMP-II, c-di-AMP, and now cGAMP.
